name: Longshore Sailing School – Junior Programs
description_short: Sailing school in Westport, CT offering junior sailing classes for ages 8-16. Options are a step-by-step Core Curriculum from beginner to advanced and one-week "camp style" specialty courses (kayaking, paddleboarding, racing, catamarans). No experience is needed.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund minus a 4% fee if you cancel 21 or more days before the course starts. No refunds or transfers within 21 days of the start date. No make-up days for missed classes. No refunds if LSS closes at the request of the Town of Westport.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim test on the first day of class, held in the pool next to the facility. Junior students must bring their own Type III lifejacket. Classes go on the water in the rain. If lightning, thunder or heavy wind keeps them off the water, the school stays open to look after students.
